name: Fujisan, sacred place and source of artistic inspiration
description: Rising 3,776 metres on Honshu, about 100 km southwest of Tokyo, Mount Fuji is Japan's tallest peak and a near-perfect volcanic cone, capped with snow for roughly five months a year. Pilgrims have climbed it for centuries, and its shrines, lakes and springs are still revered. Its image in woodblock prints made it a global symbol of Japan.
